finishes.name: Polished
finishes.description: A reflective finish that increases color depth and highlights mineral movement. Common for vanity tops, counters, and furniture.

finishes.name: Honed
finishes.description: A smooth low-sheen finish with softer light reflection and a calm architectural appearance.

finishes.name: Leathered / Brushed
finishes.description: A tactile low-gloss finish that emphasizes natural grain and helps reduce visible fingerprints on darker stone.
